probe.text_sample: The best way to design and develop your home in the country – Huts Housing Solutions Standards How it Works Portfolio Resources Get Started The best way to design and develop a property in the country Get Started Whatever type of place you have in mind Starter Home Starter Home First-time home buyer and don’t know where to start? We get it. Learn about the Starter Home Forever Home Forever Home You’ve traded up and are ready to create your memory palace. It’s one part home, one part work space, one part hotel for the in-law. Learn about the Forever Home Second Home Second Home You’ve worked hard, and now you want a place that works for you—a second home that feels like a first priority. Learn about the Second Home Hybrid Home Hybrid Home We get it. You rent in your city, but want to own a place. All the existing homes you’ve looked at kind of suck, or look like a big, expensive project to renovate. Learn about the Hybrid Home ADU ADU An ADU can be a guest house, a rental, a home office, or a soft landing spot for family—but the real magic is how much flexibility it adds to your property and your life.
